title: refactor: remove Interface layer, flatten to App → Page → View
body:
Eliminates the `InterfaceSchema` abstraction layer, reducing the UI hierarchy from 4 levels (App → Interface → Page → View) to 3 (App → Page → View). App now owns the full navigation tree with unlimited nesting depth, and absorbs Interface's sharing/embed capabilities.

### Schema changes (`app.zod.ts`)

- **Removed**: `InterfaceNavItemSchema`, `interfaces[]`, `defaultInterface`
- **Added**: `sharing` (SharingConfigSchema) and `embed` (EmbedConfigSchema) on AppSchema
- **Restored**: `navigation[]` as full unlimited-depth sidebar tree (was limited to utility-only entries)

```typescript
const crm = defineApp({
  name: 'crm',
  label: 'Sales CRM',
  navigation: [
    { id: 'grp_sales', type: 'group', label: 'Sales Cloud', expanded: true, children: [
      { id: 'nav_pipeline', type: 'page', label: 'Pipeline', pageName: 'page_pipeline' },
      { id: 'grp_review', type: 'group', label: 'Lead Review', children: [  // ← nested groups, impossible before
        { id: 'nav_queue', type: 'page', label: 'Queue', pageName: 'page_review_queue' },
      ]},
    ]},
  ],
  sharing: { enabled: true },
});
```

### Deleted files
- `src/ui/interface.zod.ts`, `src/ui/interface.test.ts`
- `examples/app-crm/src/interfaces/*.interface.ts` (3 files)

### Renamed
- `studio/interface-builder.zod.ts` → `studio/page-builder.zod.ts`
- `InterfaceBuilderConfigSchema` → `PageBuilderConfigSchema` (deprecated alias retained)

### Exports
- Removed `defineInterface` from root and UI index
- Removed `export * from './interface.zod'` from UI barrel

### Test migration
- ~80 tests from deleted `interface.test.ts` that tested `PageSchema`, `RecordReviewConfigSchema`, `BlankPageLayoutSchema`, component prop schemas, etc. were migrated to `page.test.ts` and `component.test.ts`
- 200 test files, 5519 tests pass, `tsc --noEmit` clean

### Docs
- ROADMAP.md updated (removed Interface references, updated version table)
- `airtable-interface-gap-analysis.md` marked as SUPERSEDED
- `visual-design-ux-optimization.md` updated (Interface → Page references)
- Studio ROADMAP updated (Interface Builder → Page Builder)

### 核心设计：新的 AppSchema

```typescript
// 新的 app.zod.ts 核心变化

export const AppSchema = z.object({
  name: SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema,
  label: I18nLabelSchema,
  version: z.string().optional(),
  description: I18nLabelSchema.optional(),
  icon: z.string().optional(),
  branding: AppBrandingSchema.optional(),
  active: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
  isDefault: z.boolean().optional().default(false),

  /** 
   * 完整的导航树 —— 支持无限层级
   * 不再区分 "main navigation" 和 "utility navigation"
   */
  navigation: z.array(NavigationItemSchema).optional()
    .describe('Full navigation tree for the app sidebar'),
  
  homePageId: z.string().optional(),
  requiredPermissions: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  
  /** 分享/嵌入能力从 Interface 提升到 App 级别 */
  sharing: SharingConfigSchema.optional(),
  embed: EmbedConfigSchema.optional(),
  
  /** 移动端导航 */
  mobileNavigation: z.object({ /* ... 不变 ... */ }).optional(),
  aria: AriaPropsSchema.optional(),
});
```

### NavigationItemSchema 变化

```typescript
// 删掉 InterfaceNavItemSchema

export const NavigationItemSchema: z.ZodType<any> = z.lazy(() => 
  z.union([
    ObjectNavItemSchema.extend({
      children: z.array(NavigationItemSchema).optional(),
    }),
    DashboardNavItemSchema,
    PageNavItemSchema,        // ← Page 直接挂在导航树上
    UrlNavItemSchema,
    // ❌ InterfaceNavItemSchema — 删除
    GroupNavItemSchema.extend({
      children: z.array(NavigationItemSchema),
    }),
  ])
);
```

### Interface 的有用属性迁移到哪里？

| Interface 属性 | 迁移去向 | 说明 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `pages[]` | **App.navigation** 树中用 `type: 'page'` 引用 | Page 本身保持独立定义 |
| `assignedRoles` | **App.requiredPermissions** + Page 级别的 `assignedProfiles` | 已存在 |
| `sharing` / `embed` | **App** 级别 或 **Page** 级别 | `SharingConfigSchema` 保留 |
| `branding` / `coverImage` | **App.branding** | 已存在 |
| `group` | **NavigationItem type: 'group'** | 已存在 |
| `icon` | **NavigationItem.icon** | 已存在 |
| `homePageName` | **App.homePageId** | 已存在 |
| `object` | **Page.object** | 已存在 |
| `defineInterface()` | 🗑 删除 | 用 `defineApp()` |

**之前（三个 Interface 文件 + 一个 App 文件）：**
